Nora (PM): quick huddle: proposing three prioritized slices for the Efficiency Adviser: Quick-Enable, Ops-Controls, Enterprise-Assured. Need alignment on acceptance criteria and infra deps.
Evan (Eng): sounds good. call out infra primitives: prefix cache API, batching policy runtime, safe quantization path.
Mina (ML): add concordance guard (nightly check) and a manual review gate for quant suggestions. recommend flag at >2% output delta.
Raj (Solutions): field teams need a simple ROI calc. suggest shipping a CSV template (tokens/session, sessions/day, cost/token, expected % save).
Nora (PM): draft slices below:

Quick-Enable
- Audience: self-serve devs
- Surface: Console tips + read-only recs, one-click batching preset
- Acceptance: feature-flag rollout, <1 extra api call, CSV ROI available
- Impact: ~8-15% cost reduction

Ops-Controls
- Audience: platform/ops teams
- Surface: batching DSL, KV-prefix cache policies, nightly eval alerts to console/Sentry
- Acceptance: documented tradeoffs, mute/throttle controls, visible eval diffs
- Impact: ~20-35% cost reduction, p95 may rise for some flows

Enterprise-Assured
- Audience: dedicated/private customers
- Surface: API automation, canary-by-tenant, signed quant diffs, auto-hold/backout with audit logs, KMS compatibility
- Acceptance: security signoff, SLIs for auto-backout, integration tests for KMS paths
- Impact: 25-50% cost savings for high-volume workloads

Tess (ProdDev): I'll add checklist items in JIRA (audit logs, rollback, SLIs).
Evan (Eng): will prototype prefix-cache + minimal batch DSL next week.
Mina (ML): I'll deliver an eval snippet and taxonomy (sample/model/infra alerts) by Wed.
Raj (Solutions): will prepare SE one-pager and two customer vignettes for ROI (Shoply, AcmeHealth).
Nora (PM): priority for Q3: Quick-Enable then Ops-Controls. Enterprise-Assured Q4. locking Friday unless blockers. ops-bot: created OPT-799 Efficiency Adviser slices (assignee: Nora).
Nora (PM): keep launch line simple: "Efficiency Adviser reduces token cost with safe, explainable recommendations."
Evan (Eng): noted, will flag infra blockers early.
Mina (ML): adding harness tomorrow.
Raj (Solutions): collecting usage samples for ROI.
Nora (PM): thanks all, closing loop.
